name: todoflow_create_task
description: Create a new task in TodoFlow with optional project, priority, due date, recurrence, and checklist items.

description.description: Detailed description or notes in Markdown

dueDate.description: Due date in ISO format (e.g. '2026-10-15T18:00:00Z' or '2026-10-15')

projectName.description: Name of the project. If project doesn't exist, it will be automatically created.

subtasks.description: Array of subtask checklist titles to create under this task

name: todoflow_create_tasks_batch
description: Create multiple tasks in TodoFlow at once (useful for planning, checklists, project setups).

dueDate.description: Due date in ISO format or YYYY-MM-DD

name: todoflow_list_tasks
description: List tasks from TodoFlow with filters (smart views: inbox, today, upcoming, overdue, or by project name/status).

search.description: Filter by substring in title or description

name: todoflow_complete_task
description: Mark a task as completed (or active) in TodoFlow. Triggers recurrence generation automatically if task is recurring.

taskId.description: UUID of the task to complete

name: todoflow_add_subtasks
description: Add checklist subtasks to an existing task in TodoFlow.

subtasks.description: List of subtask titles to add

name: todoflow_create_project
description: Create a new project in TodoFlow.

name: todoflow_get_task
description: Get full details of a specific task including description, subtasks, checklist progress, priority, due date, project, and labels.

taskId.description: UUID of the task to retrieve

name: todoflow_update_task
description: Update an existing task in TodoFlow (title, description, priority, due date, project, or completion).

taskId.description: UUID of the task to update

dueDate.description: Due date in ISO format (e.g. '2026-10-20T18:00:00Z' or '2026-10-20')

projectName.description: Move task to this project (automatically created if it doesn't exist)

projectId.description: Move task to this project ID

clearProject.description: Set to true to remove project and move task to Inbox

name: todoflow_delete_task
description: Permanently delete a task by ID from TodoFlow.

taskId.description: UUID of the task to delete

name: todoflow_toggle_subtask
description: Update or toggle completion of a subtask checklist item on a task.

completed.description: Completion status of the subtask (default: true)

title.description: Optional new title for the subtask

name: todoflow_add_comment
description: Add a note, progress update, or comment to a task.

content.description: Comment or note in markdown or plaintext

name: todoflow_list_comments
description: List all comments and notes on a task.

name: todoflow_list_labels
description: List all available labels/tags in TodoFlow.

name: todoflow_create_label
description: Create a new label/tag in TodoFlow.

name: todoflow_daily_briefing
description: Get an executive daily briefing of tasks: overdue items, today's priority schedule, upcoming deadlines, and key statistics.
